metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: FUPDEC crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C72 H92 Cl6 Cu4 Dy4 N16 O28 2+,9(C1 H4 O1),3(H2 O1),2(Cl1 1-). From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Cu1 (Cu) has 0 O neighbors; Cu2 (Cu) has 1 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy4 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Cu3 (Cu) has 0 O neighbors; Cu4 (Cu) has 1 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 3 pairs, 5 components; largest component is a chain with approximately linear metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.908-4.087 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 111.03-117.49°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Cu4Dy4L4Cl6(CH3OH)8(H2O)4]Cl2(CH3OH)9(H2O)2 (Cu4Dy4C81H133N16O40Cl8). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 4 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 4 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 2 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
